title: AI Cluster Schema
description: Orchestrate AI model execution with conversation memory and tool support

prompt.description: The user prompt/message to send to the AI model

system_prompt.description: Optional system prompt to guide the AI's behavior

response_format.description: Expected response format - 'text' for plain text or 'json' for structured JSON

provider.description: AI provider to use (credentials come from profile)

model.description: Specific model variant (optional, defaults to provider default)

temperature.description: Controls randomness. Higher values mean more random, lower values more deterministic

max_tokens.description: Maximum number of tokens to generate

include_history.description: Whether to include conversation history from memory

memory_key.description: Memory key for storing/retrieving conversation history (required if include_history is true)

max_history_messages.description: Maximum number of history messages to include in context

profile.title: Profile Schema
profile.description: Credentials and authentication (uses AI credentials profile)

profileKeys.description: Profile keys for AI provider credentials (e.g., 'ai-credentials')

response.description: Parsed AI response (text or JSON object)

raw_response.description: Raw response text from the AI model

parse_success.description: Whether the response was successfully parsed according to requested format

metadata.description: Execution metadata (token usage, cost, latency, etc.)
